rows.grounds: compound nānā-prakāra-pūjā with asyāḥ; internal sandhi pūjā+asyāḥ
distributive repetition of tantre (locative of tantra)
past participle describing worship as made known

items.question: In which scriptures is the manifold worship of this goddess revealed?
premises: The goddess possesses manifold forms of worship.
Tantric scriptures serve as sources of revealed instruction.
This worship is stated to be made known in those scriptures.
items.inference: Therefore, the manifold worship of this goddess is revealed in each tantra.
uncertainties: The referent of asyāḥ is inferred from the preceding verses describing Akṣobhya's consort.
items.plain_english: Her worship of many kinds is revealed in tantra after tantra.
